problems.name: Evidence-qualified records not released to the Chinese graph
problems.definition: Declared automatic evidence gate passed but source-record identity not in standard1326; not LLM-generation omission or expert-confirmed missed facts.
problems.diagnosis_impact: Potential source evidence unavailable to downstream graph queries; actual diagnostic relevance is not established for every record.
problems.data_sufficiency: 372 traceable records, but no independent semantic completeness labels.
problems.engineering: Terminology status/protected-token governance first; lowering thresholds does not verify meaning.
problems.evaluation_boundary: Can prove version membership and executable gate reason, not factual recall or safe usability.

problems.name: Source-surface identity split and type ambiguity
problems.definition: Same typed conservative source form maps to more than one published node; unlike same label with different types, it is an alignment candidate, not automatic equivalence.

metric.meaning: 10 implicated nodes in 5 candidate groups; candidate incidence, not an error rate

problems.diagnosis_impact: Equivalent symptoms/actions can fragment retrieval and apparent chains.
problems.data_sufficiency: Only five probe groups; no evidence that a learned aligner is necessary.
problems.engineering: Dictionary/nominalization cleanup is plausible; four-group AI review and all-five hypothetical merge are not interchangeable.
problems.algorithm_research: NO-GO for a new aligner justified only by these cases
problems.evaluation_boundary: Shows lexical splits and sensitivity without proving general semantic equivalence.

problems.name: Polarity and normative/observational meaning mismatch
problems.definition: Positive graph reading is not justified by the source prohibition or design obligation; source location and legal endpoint types do not establish entailment.

metric.meaning: At least 3 AI-audited semantic mismatches among 1326; targeted English probes, not an unbiased defect-rate estimate

problems.diagnosis_impact: A prohibition may become an unsuitable operating condition; a design requirement may become an unsupported causal explanation.
problems.data_sufficiency: Three source-anchored cases plus one retained-negation counterexample; too small for algorithm efficacy claims.
problems.engineering: Known cases allow conservative blocking/correction; generic operator preservation still needs empirical assessment, not assumed inability of rules.
problems.evaluation_boundary: Source-proposition mismatch, not proof of real-world causal impossibility or equipment diagnostic accuracy.

problems.name: Declared domain scope not respected by some source propositions
problems.definition: Published targets explicitly name other machinery despite a document scope restricted to pumps/piping; transferable mechanisms remain unresolved rather than automatically excluded.

metric.meaning: 7 AI-supported out-of-declared-scope records observed; 10 keyword candidates reviewed, 3 scope-transfer cases unresolved; not full corpus error rate

problems.diagnosis_impact: Propeller/crankshaft procedures may contaminate pump queries or misleading evidence chains.
problems.data_sufficiency: Ten probe records, seven supported within the declared boundary.
problems.engineering: Document/section/equipment applicability checks should precede model design.
problems.algorithm_research: NO-GO as a stand-alone innovation from current evidence
problems.evaluation_boundary: Can flag explicit scope mismatch; cannot decide all cross-machine transferability from keywords.

problems.name: Qualifiers not independently bound in semantic payload
problems.definition: Source condition/negation/modality/alternative/sequence wording may live in evidence or endpoints, with no explicit operator-bound fields. Lack of fields alone is not lost knowledge.

metric.meaning: English cue-bearing evidence records; a proxy, not 630 defective relations

source_cue_not_in_endpoints.meaning: 374 cue-category differences between evidence and endpoint text; evidence remains retained

problems.diagnosis_impact: Different operating modes, units, branches and temporal prerequisites may be used outside their actual context.
problems.data_sufficiency: Several traceable positive/counterexamples and broad lexical candidates, but no exhaustive operator-label benchmark or same-budget method failure proof.
problems.engineering: Schema/serialization and literal qualifier retention are necessary transparent controls; difficult binding cases not yet isolated from them.
problems.algorithm_research: INCONCLUSIVE; priority for further problem isolation, not a chosen architecture
problems.evaluation_boundary: Can measure observable representation placement; cannot infer global semantic loss or prevalence from cue matches.

problems.name: Fragmented topology versus actual missing knowledge
problems.definition: A FaultMode does not simultaneously have an incoming causal edge and outgoing mitigation/prevention edge; this chosen graph pattern is not a universal diagnostic requirement.
problems.diagnosis_impact: Graph traversal can stop because of naming, release selection or intentionally atomic knowledge, not because a physical causal link exists but is absent.
problems.data_sufficiency: All structural nodes checked; no independent labelled missing-edge universe.
problems.engineering: At least three gap roles occur in another existing tier; alias projection reduces four components without adding knowledge edges.
problems.algorithm_research: NO-GO for treating topology gaps as training positives or prespecifying link prediction
problems.evaluation_boundary: Can count connectivity and role incidence; cannot derive causal transitivity or evidence for a new edge.

problems.name: Sparse independent-source corroboration
problems.definition: Multiple evidence occurrences from one source family are not independent confirmations. Different-family canonical matches still require object/condition verification.

metric.meaning: 0/1281 governed claims with multiple recorded source families; metadata proxy, not proof no corroborating text exists

problems.diagnosis_impact: Repeated pages/languages can be mistaken for corroboration; generic endpoints can create false matches.
problems.data_sufficiency: One condition-supported additional evidence candidate, not a new atomic relation; no adequate independent-source truth benchmark.
problems.engineering: Source-family deduplication and retaining object-specific evidence first.
problems.algorithm_research: INCONCLUSIVE for probabilistic truth discovery; current corroboration labels inadequate
problems.evaluation_boundary: Counts recorded families, not statistical independence or truth probability.

problems.name: First-record attribute projection loss
problems.definition: For one merged claim the graph builder's retained fault_class_ids does not contain the union of its source-record tags.
problems.diagnosis_impact: A claim-level fault-category lookup may fail despite source evidence and category tags still being present.
problems.data_sufficiency: One fully traceable multi-language claim, enough for an engineering regression test but not an algorithm paper.
problems.engineering: Set-union projection is a transparent prospective repair; verify category semantics separately. No repair applied here.
problems.evaluation_boundary: Proves aggregation mismatch, not correctness of every upstream automatic fault tag.

problems.name: Export view lacks detailed native addresses but full source archive retains them
problems.definition: Evidence export and graph display omit some offsets/cells that are still stored in source_records; this is a view/interface boundary, not deleted source evidence.

metric.meaning: all standard evidence exports lack explicit evidence_start/evidence_units fields; full records retain E1/E2 data

problems.diagnosis_impact: A consumer reading only the compact view may be unable to inspect the exact table or local context.
problems.data_sufficiency: All source addresses inspected; five standard cell-text byte differences are whitespace-only, not missing evidence.
problems.engineering: Explicit source-record joins or lossless view adapters; no inferred bbox and no frozen artifact retrofit.
problems.evaluation_boundary: Shows field projection and address roundtrip, not relation entailment.

problems.name: Formal qualifier contract differs from experimental sidecars
problems.definition: v3 Claim/EvidenceAssertion definitions have no explicit conditions/polarity/modality fields; DocumentSource has broad applicability_scope, and experimental records add sidecar context outside that formal contract.

metric.meaning: 0 of the two relevant formal record definitions explicitly models the selected per-assertion operator fields; not a schema-invalid-record count

problems.diagnosis_impact: Conditions cannot yet be independently validated/queried through one common formal interface; broad document scope cannot substitute local procedure guards.
problems.data_sufficiency: Direct schema inspection establishes the interface gap, not the benefit of any particular reasoning model.
problems.engineering: Versioned schema/interface design and compatibility tests before research models; do not modify the existing frozen schema in this investigation.
problems.algorithm_research: INCONCLUSIVE for semantic binding; schema work alone is engineering
problems.evaluation_boundary: Static inspection is not full JSON-Schema conformance or factual verification.
